description: This Java class defines a custom exception 'CollateralCannotBeCreatedException' used within the collateral package of the Fineract project. It includes an inner enum to specify reasons why collateral creation might fail, and a constructor that uses this enum to instantiate exception details.

classes.description: A custom exception indicating that collateral cannot be created for a loan under certain conditions. It provides specific reasons through an inner enum and passes relevant information to its superclass.
